name: Sushiya ga Ai Shita Tono-sama
source:
Long, long ago------

The young master of a castle, Takeru, knew no other life. 
But then he fell in love with Nengo, a sushi preparer. 

This is the continued story of "The Sushi Man Who Loved His Lord". 
For those who were so kind to read the previous story, please also enjoy.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072041.html]DLsite English[/url]]
